top_signals.title: Taiwan's ETF Godfather Julian Liu on Market Momentum
top_signals.summary: Julian Liu, Chairman at Yuanta Securities Investment Trust, discusses Taiwan's ETF market and the next catalysts for 2027. He speaks exclusively on Bloomberg's ETF IQ Asia. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: IMC Trading’s Internship Ad Misfire Shows Rush for Quant Jobs
top_signals.summary: An internship at a global trading firm has become such a hot ticket that people apply with almost no information.
